providers.name: REA Playwright browser scenario capture provider

limitations: Artifact identity is unavailable for this observation.
Event sequence records provider receipt order; simultaneous browser causality is not inferred.
Network content is retained only when selected; Playwright response-body bytes are API results and are not guaranteed to match wire bytes.
Request bytes are limited to what Playwright exposes; not_exposed does not establish body absence or multipart file coverage.
Network content reads settle within 5 seconds each and the observer does not request bodies from unfinished responses.

Captured response-body bytes are the result of Playwright's Response.body() API. Playwright may satisfy that API with a credentialed follow-up load of the request URL when CDP has no body, so transaction and event links do not verify that retained bytes came from the original network transaction.
Playwright scenario events do not expose request initiator stacks; receipt order does not prove causality.
Storage values are hashed only after declared-secret redaction.
Some selected network content was unavailable; per-transaction content states retain the reason.

limitations: Event sequence records provider receipt order; simultaneous browser causality is not inferred.
Network content is retained only when selected; Playwright response-body bytes are API results and are not guaranteed to match wire bytes.
Request bytes are limited to what Playwright exposes; not_exposed does not establish body absence or multipart file coverage.
Network content reads settle within 5 seconds each and the observer does not request bodies from unfinished responses.

Playwright scenario events do not expose request initiator stacks; receipt order does not prove causality.

- document:
  - navigation:
    - link "Brilliant home":
      - /url: /
      - img
    - button "Sign in"
  - heading "Your personal tutor for math and coding" [level=1]
  - button "Pause":
    - img
  - paragraph: A world-class tutor for every home. Built by top learning experts from MIT and Harvard.
  - button "I’m a learner"
  - button "I’m a parent or teacher"
  - heading "Fully accredited" [level=3]
  - paragraph: by ACS WASC
  - heading "100,000+" [level=3]
  - paragraph: 5-star app store reviews
  - heading "10 million+" [level=3]
  - paragraph: learners around the world
  - heading "Meet Koji, your personal tutor" [level=2]
  - radiogroup "Choose a subject":
    - radio "Math" [checked]
    - radio "Coding"
  - button "Play":
    - img
  - heading "A visual, interactive tutor, not a cheating machine" [level=3]
  - paragraph: Unlike other AI chatbots and homework help tools, Koji never just gives you the answer. He ensures you actually understand math.
  - paragraph: You learn with Koji on a shared interactive canvas. He asks guiding questions, sketches on your screen, gives hints, and provides visual help.
  - paragraph: Like the best human tutors, he gets to the heart of where you’re getting stuck, and works with you until you can solve hard problems yourself.
  - button "Play":
    - img
  - heading "Adapts to exactly where you are" [level=3]
  - paragraph: Koji tracks what you’ve mastered and what you’ve missed, then builds your learning plan around the gaps.
  - paragraph: He gets you caught up on any shaky fundamentals, and personalizes your practice and review sessions to optimize your learning.
  - paragraph: He accelerates your learning plan when you’re ready, and slows down when you need it.
  - button "Play":
    - img
  - heading "Real-time progress tracking & analysis" [level=3]
  - paragraph: Visual dashboards make it easy to see what clicked, what’s still difficult, and what to do next.
  - paragraph: Parents and learners also receive regular notifications with an overview of completed lessons, performance on mastery assessments, learning strengths, and areas that need more practice.
  - heading "Effective and trusted" [level=2]
  - group "1 / 3":
    - img "Koji offering to try another approach in a lesson chat, above a prompt reading “How can I help?”"
    - heading "Lesson interventions" [level=3]
    - paragraph: Koji provides instant, one-on-one help whenever you’re stuck, just like an expert sitting right next to you.
    - paragraph: Get guidance, alternative explanations, or hints, using voice or chat.
  - group "2 / 3":
    - img "A lesson plan headed “Let’s build up a few skills first”, listing distance skills marked as made for the learner"
    - heading "Mastery assessments" [level=3]
    - paragraph: Koji makes sure you understand every concept with regular assessments. If you come up short, he creates targeted practice to get you back on track.
  - group "3 / 3":
    - link "kidSAFE COPPA Certified seal":
      - /url: https://kidsafe.com/member/brilliant
    - heading "kidSAFE CERTIFIED" [level=3]
    - paragraph: Brilliant is independently certified to meet strict U.S. standards for kids’ online privacy and safety.
    - paragraph:
      - text: Brilliant is a member in the kidSAFE Seal Program. To learn more, click on the seal or go to
      - link "www.kidsafe.com":
        - /url: https://www.kidsafe.com/
      - text: .
  - heading "From grade 5 to college and beyond" [level=2]
  - tablist:

    - tab "Data"
  - button "Play":

  - 'heading "Math: Covered topics" [level=3]'

  - img "A child using a tablet at a kitchen counter while an adult prepares food in the background"
  - heading "Always on your schedule" [level=3]
  - paragraph: Say goodbye to the chore of finding a tutor, driving to sessions, and fitting another thing into your schedule. Koji is there Sunday night before the test, Saturday morning for fun, and the quiet 20 minutes before dinner.
  - paragraph: Get a year of tutoring for the price of a few in-person sessions.
  - img "Aerial view of a university campus with historic brick buildings"
  - heading "Built by top learning experts" [level=3]
  - paragraph: Our curriculum is crafted by award-winning teachers, subject-matter experts, and learning designers from top institutions.
  - img "MIT"
  - img "Harvard University"
  - img "Stanford University"
  - img "Cornell University"
  - img "Caltech"
  - img "Students working through Brilliant lessons on laptops in a classroom"
  - heading "Trusted by thousands of schools" [level=3]
  - paragraph: Every student gets an interactive, personalized learning program – one that sees what they’re doing, gives custom feedback, and assesses for mastery. It fits into your classroom, or as homework.
  - paragraph: Free for individual classrooms. District pricing available on request.

#onetrust-banner-sdk #onetrust-policy-title {
  display: none !important;

/* ============================================
   Banner Container
   ============================================ */
#onetrust-banner-sdk {
  font-family: "CoFo Brilliant", sans-serif !important;
  padding: 24px !important;
  gap: 16px !important;
  max-width: 420px !important;
  background: #f8f8f8 !important;
  box-shadow: 0px 0px 25px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2) !important;
  border-radius: 20px !important;
  letter-spacing: normal !important;
}

@keyframes banner-slide-in {
  from {
    bottom: -100%;
  }
  to {
    bottom: 1rem;
  }
}

#onetrust-banner-sdk {
  animation: banner-slide-in 300ms ease-out forwards !important;
}

/* ============================================
   Content Layout
   ============================================ */
#onetrust-banner-sdk #onetrust-group-container,
#onetrust-banner-sdk #onetrust-policy,
#onetrust-banner-sdk #onetrust-policy-text,
#onetrust-banner-sdk .banner-header {
  margin: 0 !important;
  padding: 0 !important;
}

/* ============================================
   Policy Text and Links
   ============================================ */
#onetrust-banner-sdk #onetrust-policy-text {
  font-style: normal !important;
  font-weight: 400 !important;
  font-size: 16px !important;
  line-height: 150% !important;
  color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6) !important;
}

#onetrust-banner-sdk #onetrust-policy-text a {
  color: var(--base-blue-500, #456dff) !important;
  cursor: pointer !important;
  text-decoration: none !important;
}

#onetrust-banner-sdk #onetrust-policy-text a:hover {
  text-decoration: underline !important;
}

#onetrust-banner-sdk #onetrust-policy-text a + a::before {
  content: " | ";
}

/* ============================================
   Close Button
   ============================================ */

/* Container */
#onetrust-banner-sdk #onetrust-close-btn-container {
  position: relative !important;
  float: right !important;
}

/* Clearfix to prevent float collapse */
#onetrust-banner-sdk #onetrust-close-btn-container::after {
  content: "" !important;
  display: table !important;
  clear: both !important;
}

/* Base styles */
#onetrust-banner-sdk .onetrust-close-btn-handler {
  display: flex !important;
  flex-direction: row !important;
  justify-content: center !important;
  align-items: center !important;
  padding: 12px 24px !important;
  gap: 8px !important;
  box-sizing: border-box !important;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.01) !important;
  /* No bottom border creates rounded top edge with shadow below */
  border-width: 2px 2px 0px 2px !important;
  border-style: solid !important;
  border-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1) !important;
  box-shadow: 0px 4px 0px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1) !important;
  border-radius: 60px !important;
  font-style: normal !important;
  font-weight: 500 !important;
  font-size: 16px !important;
  line-height: 125% !important;
  text-align: center !important;
  color: #000000 !important;
  cursor: pointer !important;
  transition: all 0.2s ease !important;
  width: 100% !important;
}

/* Display button text from aria-label attribute */
#onetrust-banner-sdk .onetrust-close-btn-handler::after {
  content: attr(aria-label) !important;
}

/* Interactive states */
#onetrust-banner-sdk .onetrust-close-btn-handler:hover {
  opacity: 0.85 !important;
  border-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) !important;
  box-shadow: 0px 4px 0px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) !important;
}

/* Press down effect: remove shadow and shift button down */
#onetrust-banner-sdk .onetrust-close-btn-handler:active {
  background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05) !important;
  /* A real bottom border eats 2px out of the button's fixed 44px box, which
     squeezed the content area and nudged the label up. Painting the pressed
     bottom edge with an inset shadow costs no layout at all, so nothing moves
     but the translate. */
  border-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) !important;
  box-shadow: inset 0px -2px 0px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) !important;
  transform: translateY(4px) !important;
}

#onetrust-banner-sdk .onetrust-close-btn-handler:focus-visible {
  outline: none !important;
  box-shadow:
    0px 4px 0px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1),
    0px 0px 0px 3px #456dff !important;
}

/* Suppress the SDK default black focus outline on mouse press.
   :not(:focus-visible) leaves the keyboard focus ring above untouched. */
#onetrust-banner-sdk .onetrust-close-btn-handler:focus:not(:focus-visible) {
  outline: none !important;
}

#onetrust-pc-sdk {
  font-family: "CoFo Brilliant", sans-serif !important;
  padding: 32px !important;
  background: #FFFFFF !important;
  box-shadow: 0px 0px 25px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2) !important;
  border-radius: 20px !important;
  box-sizing: border-box !important;
}

/* The SDK wraps the panel contents in an inner flex column */
#onetrust-pc-sdk > [role="dialog"] {
  overflow: visible !important;
  display: flex !important;
  flex-direction: column !important;
  gap: 24px !important;
  width: 100% !important;
  min-height: 0 !important;
}


/* ============================================
   HEADER
   ============================================ */
/* Custom header title using SDK's aria-label */
#onetrust-pc-sdk > [role="dialog"]::before {
  content: attr(aria-label);
  position: absolute !important;
  top: 32px !important;
  left: 32px !important;
  display: flex !important;
  align-items: center !important;
  font-weight: 700 !important;
  font-size: 20px !important;
  line-height: 125% !important;
  color: #000000 !important;
  pointer-events: none !important;
}

/* Hide default title and logo */
#onetrust-pc-sdk #ot-pc-title {
  display: none !important;
}

#onetrust-pc-sdk .ot-pc-logo {
  display: none;
}

#onetrust-pc-sdk .ot-pc-header {
  display: flex !important;
  justify-content: space-between !important;
  align-items: center !important;
  width: 100% !important;
  padding: 0 !important;
  margin: 0 !important;
  border: none !important;
}

/* ============================================
   FOCUS -- KEYBOARD ONLY
   OneTrust paints its focus outline on :focus, so it also appears after a
   mouse click. Suppress it for pointer focus and re-draw it only for
   :focus-visible (keyboard / assistive tech).
   ============================================ */

#onetrust-consent-sdk #onetrust-pc-sdk :focus:not(:focus-visible),
#onetrust-pc-sdk :focus:not(:focus-visible) {
  outline: none !important;
  outline-offset: 0 !important;
}

/* Controls where the visible target is a sibling of the focused input */
#onetrust-pc-sdk .ot-tgl input:focus:not(:focus-visible) + .ot-switch,
#onetrust-pc-sdk input[type="checkbox"]:focus:not(:focus-visible) + .ot-acc-hdr,
#onetrust-pc-sdk .ot-chkbox input[type="checkbox"]:focus:not(:focus-visible) + label::before,
#onetrust-pc-sdk .ot-checkbox input[type="checkbox"]:focus:not(:focus-visible) + label::before {
  outline: none !important;
}

/* Keyboard focus ring */
#onetrust-consent-sdk #onetrust-pc-sdk :focus-visible,
#onetrust-pc-sdk :focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid #456dff !important;
  outline-offset: 2px !important;
}

#onetrust-pc-sdk .ot-tgl input:focus-visible + .ot-switch,
#onetrust-pc-sdk input[type="checkbox"]:focus-visible + .ot-acc-hdr,
#onetrust-pc-sdk .ot-chkbox input[type="checkbox"]:focus-visible + label::before,
#onetrust-pc-sdk .ot-checkbox input[type="checkbox"]:focus-visible + label::before {
  outline: 2px solid #456dff !important;
  outline-offset: 2px !important;
}

/* Save Preferences: keyboard ring, keeping the drop shadow underneath */
#onetrust-pc-sdk .save-preference-btn-handler.onetrust-close-btn-handler:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid #456dff !important;
  outline-offset: 2px !important;
  box-shadow: 0px 4px 0px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1) !important;
}

/* OneTrust also dims and re-colours buttons on :focus -- undo that for
   pointer focus so the button looks untouched after a click */
#onetrust-pc-sdk .save-preference-btn-handler.onetrust-close-btn-handler:focus:not(:focus-visible):not(:hover) {
  opacity: 1 !important;
  border-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1) !important;
}

/* Active/pressed state -- last so it wins over :focus-visible when the
   button is activated from the keyboard.
   Geometry must be identical at rest and pressed: the footer height is
   content-driven, so any change to the button's padding or border width
   resizes the footer and the scroll area above it. The pressed bottom edge
   is therefore drawn with an INSET shadow, which paints inside the box and
   costs no layout. */
#onetrust-pc-sdk .save-preference-btn-handler.onetrust-close-btn-handler:active {
  background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05) !important;
  border-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) !important;
  box-shadow: inset 0px -2px 0px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) !important;
  transform: translateY(4px) !important;
}

#onetrust-banner-sdk #onetrust-policy-title {

/* ============================================
   Banner Container
   ============================================ */
#onetrust-banner-sdk {
  font-family: "CoFo Brilliant", sans-serif !important;
  padding: 24px !important;
  gap: 16px !important;
  max-width: 420px !important;
  background: #f8f8f8 !important;
  box-shadow: 0px 0px 25px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2) !important;
  border-radius: 20px !important;
  letter-spacing: normal !important;
}

@keyframes banner-slide-in {
  from {
    bottom: -100%;
  }
  to {
    bottom: 1rem;
  }
}

#onetrust-banner-sdk {
  animation: banner-slide-in 300ms ease-out forwards !important;
}

/* ============================================
   Content Layout
   ============================================ */
#onetrust-banner-sdk #onetrust-group-container,
#onetrust-banner-sdk #onetrust-policy,
#onetrust-banner-sdk #onetrust-policy-text,
#onetrust-banner-sdk .banner-header {
  margin: 0 !important;
  padding: 0 !important;
}

/* ============================================
   Policy Text and Links
   ============================================ */
#onetrust-banner-sdk #onetrust-policy-text {
  font-style: normal !important;
  font-weight: 400 !important;
  font-size: 16px !important;
  line-height: 150% !important;
  color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6) !important;
}

#onetrust-banner-sdk #onetrust-policy-text a {
  color: var(--base-blue-500, #456dff) !important;
  cursor: pointer !important;
  text-decoration: none !important;
}

#onetrust-banner-sdk #onetrust-policy-text a:hover {
  text-decoration: underline !important;
}

#onetrust-banner-sdk #onetrust-policy-text a + a::before {
  content: " | ";
}

/* ============================================
   Close Button
   ============================================ */

/* Container */
#onetrust-banner-sdk #onetrust-close-btn-container {
  position: relative !important;
  float: right !important;
}

/* Clearfix to prevent float collapse */
#onetrust-banner-sdk #onetrust-close-btn-container::after {
  content: "" !important;
  display: table !important;
  clear: both !important;
}

/* Base styles */
#onetrust-banner-sdk .onetrust-close-btn-handler {
  display: flex !important;
  flex-direction: row !important;
  justify-content: center !important;
  align-items: center !important;
  padding: 12px 24px !important;
  gap: 8px !important;
  box-sizing: border-box !important;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.01) !important;
  /* No bottom border creates rounded top edge with shadow below */
  border-width: 2px 2px 0px 2px !important;
  border-style: solid !important;
  border-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1) !important;
  box-shadow: 0px 4px 0px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1) !important;
  border-radius: 60px !important;
  font-style: normal !important;
  font-weight: 500 !important;
  font-size: 16px !important;
  line-height: 125% !important;
  text-align: center !important;
  color: #000000 !important;
  cursor: pointer !important;
  transition: all 0.2s ease !important;
  width: 100% !important;
}

/* Display button text from aria-label attribute */
#onetrust-banner-sdk .onetrust-close-btn-handler::after {
  content: attr(aria-label) !important;
}

/* Interactive states */
#onetrust-banner-sdk .onetrust-close-btn-handler:hover {
  opacity: 0.85 !important;
  border-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) !important;
  box-shadow: 0px 4px 0px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) !important;
}

/* Press down effect: remove shadow and shift button down */
#onetrust-banner-sdk .onetrust-close-btn-handler:active {
  background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05) !important;
  /* A real bottom border eats 2px out of the button's fixed 44px box, which
     squeezed the content area and nudged the label up. Painting the pressed
     bottom edge with an inset shadow costs no layout at all, so nothing moves
     but the translate. */
  border-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) !important;
  box-shadow: inset 0px -2px 0px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) !important;

#onetrust-pc-sdk {
  font-family: "CoFo Brilliant", sans-serif !important;
  padding: 32px !important;
  background: #FFFFFF !important;
  box-shadow: 0px 0px 25px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2) !important;
  border-radius: 20px !important;
  box-sizing: border-box !important;
}

/* The SDK wraps the panel contents in an inner flex column */
#onetrust-pc-sdk > [role="dialog"] {
  overflow: visible !important;
  display: flex !important;
  flex-direction: column !important;
  gap: 24px !important;
  width: 100% !important;
  min-height: 0 !important;
}


/* ============================================
   HEADER
   ============================================ */
/* Custom header title using SDK's aria-label */
#onetrust-pc-sdk > [role="dialog"]::before {
  content: attr(aria-label);
  position: absolute !important;
  top: 32px !important;
  left: 32px !important;
  display: flex !important;
  align-items: center !important;
  font-weight: 700 !important;
  font-size: 20px !important;
  line-height: 125% !important;
  color: #000000 !important;
  pointer-events: none !important;
}

/* Hide default title and logo */
#onetrust-pc-sdk #ot-pc-title {
  display: none !important;
}

#onetrust-pc-sdk .ot-pc-logo {
  display: none;
}

#onetrust-pc-sdk .ot-pc-header {

/* ============================================
   Banner Container
   ============================================ */
#onetrust-banner-sdk {
  font-family: "CoFo Brilliant", sans-serif !important;
  padding: 24px !important;
  gap: 16px !important;
  max-width: 420px !important;
  background: #f8f8f8 !important;
  box-shadow: 0px 0px 25px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2) !important;
  border-radius: 20px !important;
  letter-spacing: normal !important;
}

@keyframes banner-slide-in {
  from {
    bottom: -100%;
  }
  to {
    bottom: 1rem;
  }
}

#onetrust-banner-sdk {
  animation: banner-slide-in 300ms ease-out forwards !important;
}

/* ============================================
   Content Layout
   ============================================ */
#onetrust-banner-sdk #onetrust-group-container,
#onetrust-banner-sdk #onetrust-policy,
#onetrust-banner-sdk #onetrust-policy-text,
#onetrust-banner-sdk .banner-header {
  margin: 0 !important;
  padding: 0 !important;
}

/* ============================================
   Policy Text and Links
   ============================================ */
#onetrust-banner-sdk #onetrust-policy-text {
  font-style: normal !important;
  font-weight: 400 !important;
  font-size: 16px !important;
  line-height: 150% !important;
  color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6) !important;
}

#onetrust-banner-sdk #onetrust-policy-text a {
  color: var(--base-blue-500, #456dff) !important;
  cursor: pointer !important;
  text-decoration: none !important;
}

#onetrust-banner-sdk #onetrust-policy-text a:hover {
  text-decoration: underline !important;
}

#onetrust-banner-sdk #onetrust-policy-text a + a::before {
  content: " | ";
}

/* ============================================
   Close Button
   ============================================ */

/* Container */
#onetrust-banner-sdk #onetrust-close-btn-container {
  position: relative !important;
  float: right !important;
}

/* Clearfix to prevent float collapse */
#onetrust-banner-sdk #onetrust-close-btn-container::after {
  content: "" !important;
  display: table !important;
  clear: both !important;
}

/* Base styles */
#onetrust-banner-sdk .onetrust-close-btn-handler {
  display: flex !important;
  flex-direction: row !important;
  justify-content: center !important;
  align-items: center !important;
  padding: 12px 24px !important;
  gap: 8px !important;
  box-sizing: border-box !important;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.01) !important;
  /* No bottom border creates rounded top edge with shadow below */
  border-width: 2px 2px 0px 2px !important;
  border-style: solid !important;
  border-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1) !important;
  box-shadow: 0px 4px 0px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1) !important;
  border-radius: 60px !important;
  font-style: normal !important;
  font-weight: 500 !important;
  font-size: 16px !important;
  line-height: 125% !important;
  text-align: center !important;
  color: #000000 !important;
  cursor: pointer !important;
  transition: all 0.2s ease !important;
  width: 100% !important;
}

/* Display button text from aria-label attribute */
#onetrust-banner-sdk .onetrust-close-btn-handler::after {
  content: attr(aria-label) !important;
}

/* Interactive states */
#onetrust-banner-sdk .onetrust-close-btn-handler:hover {
  opacity: 0.85 !important;
  border-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) !important;
  box-shadow: 0px 4px 0px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) !important;
}

/* Press down effect: remove shadow and shift button down */
#onetrust-banner-sdk .onetrust-close-btn-handler:active {
  background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05) !important;
  /* A real bottom border eats 2px out of the button's fixed 44px box, which
     squeezed the content area and nudged the label up. Painting the pressed
     bottom edge with an inset shadow costs no layout at all, so nothing moves
     but the translate. */
  border-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) !important;
  box-shadow: inset 0px -2px 0px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) !important;
  transform: translateY(4px) !important;
}

#onetrust-banner-sdk .onetrust-close-btn-handler:focus-visible {
  outline: none !important;
  box-shadow:
    0px 4px 0px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1),
    0px 0px 0px 3px #456dff !important;
}

/* Suppress the SDK default black focus outline on mouse press.
   :not(:focus-visible) leaves the keyboard focus ring above untouched. */
#onetrust-banner-sdk .onetrust-close-btn-handler:focus:not(:focus-visible) {
  outline: none !important;
}

#onetrust-pc-sdk {
  font-family: "CoFo Brilliant", sans-serif !important;
  padding: 32px !important;
  background: #FFFFFF !important;
  box-shadow: 0px 0px 25px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2) !important;
  border-radius: 20px !important;
  box-sizing: border-box !important;
}

/* The SDK wraps the panel contents in an inner flex column */
#onetrust-pc-sdk > [role="dialog"] {
  overflow: visible !important;
  display: flex !important;
  flex-direction: column !important;
  gap: 24px !important;
  width: 100% !important;
  min-height: 0 !important;
}


/* ============================================
   HEADER
   ============================================ */
/* Custom header title using SDK's aria-label */
#onetrust-pc-sdk > [role="dialog"]::before {
  content: attr(aria-label);
  position: absolute !important;
  top: 32px !important;
  left: 32px !important;
  display: flex !important;
  align-items: center !important;
  font-weight: 700 !important;
  font-size: 20px !important;
  line-height: 125% !important;
  color: #000000 !important;
  pointer-events: none !important;
}

/* Hide default title and logo */
#onetrust-pc-sdk #ot-pc-title {
  display: none !important;
}

#onetrust-pc-sdk .ot-pc-logo {
  display: none;
}

#onetrust-pc-sdk .ot-pc-header {

  justify-content: space-between !important;

}

#onetrust-pc-sdk .ot-pc-footer.ot-pc-scrollbar {
  /* let the button drop shadow + focus ring paint outside the footer box */
  overflow: visible !important;
  border: none !important;
  width: 100% !important;
  max-width: 100% !important;
  flex: 0 0 auto !important;
  bottom: 0 !important;
  /* room for the 4px button drop shadow inside the footer box */
  padding: 0 0 4px !important;
  margin: 0 !important;
}

/* Hide OneTrust branding */
#onetrust-pc-sdk .ot-pc-footer-logo {
  display: none;
}

#onetrust-pc-sdk .ot-btn-container {
  display: flex !important;
  justify-content: flex-end !important;
}

#onetrust-pc-sdk .save-preference-btn-handler.onetrust-close-btn-handler {
  margin-right: 0px !important;
  margin-bottom: 0px !important;
  display: flex !important;
  flex-direction: row !important;

  padding: 12px 24px !important;
  gap: 8px !important;
  box-sizing: border-box !important;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.01) !important;
  border-width: 2px 2px 0px 2px !important;
  border-style: solid !important;
  border-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1) !important;
  box-shadow: 0px 4px 0px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1) !important;
  border-radius: 60px !important;
  font-style: normal !important;
  font-weight: 500 !important;
  font-size: 16px !important;
  line-height: 125% !important;
  text-align: center !important;
  color: #000000 !important;
  cursor: pointer !important;
  transition: all 0.2s ease !important;
}

/* Hover state */
#onetrust-pc-sdk .save-preference-btn-handler.onetrust-close-btn-handler:hover {
  opacity: 0.85 !important;
  border-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) !important;
  box-shadow: 0px 4px 0px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) !important;
}

/* ============================================
   FOCUS -- KEYBOARD ONLY
   OneTrust paints its focus outline on :focus, so it also appears after a
   mouse click. Suppress it for pointer focus and re-draw it only for
   :focus-visible (keyboard / assistive tech).
   ============================================ */

#onetrust-consent-sdk #onetrust-pc-sdk :focus:not(:focus-visible),
#onetrust-pc-sdk :focus:not(:focus-visible) {
  outline: none !important;
  outline-offset: 0 !important;
}

/* Controls where the visible target is a sibling of the focused input */
#onetrust-pc-sdk .ot-tgl input:focus:not(:focus-visible) + .ot-switch,
#onetrust-pc-sdk input[type="checkbox"]:focus:not(:focus-visible) + .ot-acc-hdr,
#onetrust-pc-sdk .ot-chkbox input[type="checkbox"]:focus:not(:focus-visible) + label::before,
#onetrust-pc-sdk .ot-checkbox input[type="checkbox"]:focus:not(:focus-visible) + label::before {
  outline: none !important;
}

/* Keyboard focus ring */
#onetrust-consent-sdk #onetrust-pc-sdk :focus-visible,
#onetrust-pc-sdk :focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid #456dff !important;
  outline-offset: 2px !important;
}

#onetrust-pc-sdk .ot-tgl input:focus-visible + .ot-switch,
#onetrust-pc-sdk input[type="checkbox"]:focus-visible + .ot-acc-hdr,
#onetrust-pc-sdk .ot-chkbox input[type="checkbox"]:focus-visible + label::before,
#onetrust-pc-sdk .ot-checkbox input[type="checkbox"]:focus-visible + label::before {
  outline: 2px solid #456dff !important;
  outline-offset: 2px !important;
}

/* Save Preferences: keyboard ring, keeping the drop shadow underneath */
#onetrust-pc-sdk .save-preference-btn-handler.onetrust-close-btn-handler:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid #456dff !important;
  outline-offset: 2px !important;
  box-shadow: 0px 4px 0px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1) !important;
}

/* OneTrust also dims and re-colours buttons on :focus -- undo that for
   pointer focus so the button looks untouched after a click */
#onetrust-pc-sdk .save-preference-btn-handler.onetrust-close-btn-handler:focus:not(:focus-visible):not(:hover) {
  opacity: 1 !important;
  border-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1) !important;
}

/* Active/pressed state -- last so it wins over :focus-visible when the
   button is activated from the keyboard.
   Geometry must be identical at rest and pressed: the footer height is
   content-driven, so any change to the button's padding or border width
   resizes the footer and the scroll area above it. The pressed bottom edge
   is therefore drawn with an INSET shadow, which paints inside the box and
   costs no layout. */
#onetrust-pc-sdk .save-preference-btn-handler.onetrust-close-btn-handler:active {
  background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05) !important;
  border-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) !important;
  box-shadow: inset 0px -2px 0px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) !important;
  transform: translateY(4px) !important;
}
